case_name: Pramila Suman Singh v State of Maharashtra and Others

statutes.act: Provides That On Publication Of The Slum Rehabilitation Scheme The Other Provisions Of The Act
Empowers The State Rehabilitation Authority To Make Regulations Consistent With The Provisions Of The Act

facts: In the Metropolitan Town of Mumbai there exist a large number of Slums.
55 % population of Greater Bombay does not have authorized shelter.
Nearly 2525 hectares of lands in the City are under slums.

Lands occupied by slums are allocated for different users, and are designated, reserved or allotted for various existing or proposed public purposes in the draft or final revised Development Plan of Greater Bombay.
issues: The legal questions or points of law being debated
